name: Dental (Modern Cosmetic)
tagline: A crisp, modern template for cosmetic dental studios — book consults online from day one.
description: A modern cosmetic-and-general dental studio site — a crisp porcelain palette, a deep-teal primary and a refined serif display, with a calm, spa-like structure. Installs a working booking flow: free consults plus whitening, aligners, veneers and implants, clinicians and treatment suites as bookable resources (a visit reserves a provider AND a suite), and a cosmetic-consult deposit policy. Ships as "Arch Dental Studio".
